## ✅ RTL treatment added

I updated the prompt row so it respects locale direction and flips the icon/text ordering in RTL locales.

What changed:
- Added `direction: inherit` to the prompt container so it follows the page direction
- Set `flex-direction: row` by default
- Added `:dir(rtl) .gs-agent-shell__prompt-muted { flex-direction: row-reverse; }`

This makes the sparkles icon sit on the correct leading side in RTL layouts while still centering the whole prompt block.

I also verified the exact patch in the component diff to confirm the RTL override is present.
